params.name: ai_enabled
params.description: Filters by templates which have been set as AI Ready.

params.name: has_store
params.description: Returns templates that include a store.

params.name: has_blog
params.description: Returns templates that include a blog.

params.name: store_type
params.description: Filter by store type: NATIVE or THIRDPARTY.

params.name: editor
params.description: Filter by editor type: ADVANCED or ADVANCED-2.0.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by template type: DUDA or CUSTOM.

params.name: page_count
params.description: Return templates with an exact page count.

params.name: page_count.gte
params.description: Return templates with a minimum number of pages.

params.name: page_count.lte
params.description: Return templates with a maximum number of pages.

params.name: name.contains
params.description: Perform a text-based search within templates.

params.name: sort
params.description: Choose sorting field. Currently only NAME.

params.name: direction
params.description: Choose direction of sort. ASC or DESC.

params.name: categories
params.description: Filters by one or more category labels. Multiple values separated by comma.
